messages.subject: 2d plot overlays on regional map
parts:
Dear all

Would like to overlay 2-d plots from ggplot on a map (grouped by
region). Is this possible here or through something else?

eg. monthly mean rainfall on a states basis.

Cheers
Andrew

messages.author: 9ff02ee016b8a9e0
messages.subject: Re: 2d plot overlays on regional map
parts:
Maybe something like this:

require(ggplot2)

try_require("maps") 
nz <- data.frame(map("nz", plot=FALSE)[c("x","y")]) 
nzmap <- qplot(x, y, data=nz, geom="path")

gplot <- ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = mpg, y = hp)) + geom_point()


grid.newpage()
pushViewport(viewport(layout = grid.layout(2,2)))
vplayout <- function(x, y)
  viewport(layout.pos.row = x, layout.pos.col = y)
vplot <- viewport(width = 0.35, height = 0.35, x = 0.28, y = 0.75)
print(nzmap, vp = vplayout(1:2, 1:2))
print(gplot, vp = vplot)



Scott
